_comment: Does geometric augmentation buy anything? A PAIRED comparison: the same cell with train_augmentation off and on, and the same number of rounds for both, because augmentation trades early convergence for a later and higher plateau - giving it five rounds against a baseline that peaks at round 3 would answer a different question. 15 rounds, early stopping disabled, so both arms are read at their own best round. Rotation, translation and scale only: no flip (GTSRB has mirror-image class pairs, so a flip relabels one class as another) and nothing photometric (brightness and contrast are two of the corruptions this project evaluates). One partial overlap stays and belongs in the write-up: elastic_transform, one of the four unseen corruptions, is a geometric warp - local rather than rigid, but not unrelated.
